field_principles.cheapest_kill_gate_per_route: The smallest experiment that would bound each route cheaply -- so a seeded route gets a kill-gate, not an open-ended scale commitment (the Phase-Validation discipline).
field_principles.each_route_sidesteps_both_negatives: For each route, the explicit reason it is NOT a re-grind of the bounded selection OR generation routes -- prevents proposing a doomed re-test.
field_principles.inference_substrate: aggregation_from_upstream_artifacts (principle: a literature/menu synthesis, no live model).
field_principles.loop_will_not_self_seed: BARE bool, true -- explicitly records that this is a menu for HUMAN seeding, not a route the loop commits to (the standing finding).
field_principles.ranked_thesis_menu: The ordered list of routes with anchor/why-sidesteps/kill-gate/risk -- the decision surface for the operator; the core deliverable.
field_principles.supersedes_340_menu: BARE bool, true -- records that this menu reconciled + superseded the .340 exp3722 menu (post-Thesis-A-bound), rather than emitting an unlinked parallel menu (anti-churn).
field_principles.top_recommended_route: The single highest-ranked route (expected EDLM residual-corrector) with its one-line rationale -- a clear recommendation the operator can accept or override.
